sampling.dense_scalar_policy: For each nominal target, use the minimum of target and each branch latest complete native checkpoint as common physical time; linearly interpolate dense scalar histories only within their saved time range, record exact bracket times/gaps and fraction, and prohibit extrapolation. Native fields remain direct saved snapshots with their actual time offset.
sampling.front_metric: maximum x of native cell centres inside own lineAZone/lineBZone downstream segment x=2.25..4.80 m for alpha.water >= 0.01/0.5/0.99; cell-centre threshold, no interface interpolation
sampling.front_pressure_region: pure-gas line cells (alpha.water <= 0.01) sharing a native owner-neighbour face with mixed cells (0.01 < alpha.water < 0.99), restricted to each own lineZone and cell-centre x=2.25..4.80 m; excludes tank headspace/exterior
sampling.gas_Mach: native U/T cell values, |U|/sqrt(gamma*R*T), gamma=1.399814036958902 and R=287.0474909771845 J/kg/K
sampling.gas_phase_threshold: alpha.water <= 0.01; gas Tmin and pressure at that cell reported in each line/headspace zone
sampling.mouth_metric_basis: sampled VTP cell-centre windows with exact triangulated face areas; alpha.water and U are interpolated sampled fields, so alpha*U and momentum are observer estimates, not native alphaPhi fluxes
sampling.segment_inventory: sum(alpha.water * native cellVolume) inside lineZone x-centres 2.25..4.80 m; distinct from the broader lineAInitialZone/lineBInitialZone observer ledger
